meta.title: Linear Charge Density Converter — Convert Coulomb/meter and More
meta.description: Free linear charge density converter for 3+ units including Coulomb/meter, Coulomb/centimeter, Coulomb/inch. Instant, accurate, browser-based.

content.intro: C/m, C/cm, C/in. Convert between 3 linear charge density units instantly, with engineering-grade precision and no signup required.
content.result_section: Pick any two units below to convert between them. The base unit for linear charge density in this tool is **Cm**; every conversion routes through it for consistency.
content.formula_section: Most linear charge density conversions are a single multiplication by a fixed factor. Temperature is the notable exception — it uses additive offsets, not just multiplication. The converter handles both transparently.

content.tips:
Bookmark the conversions you use most — each pair has its own dedicated page with formulas, a lookup table, and FAQs.

When working with derived units (area, volume), remember the factor scales with the dimension: a length factor f becomes f² for area and f³ for volume.
content.faq:
**Q:** How accurate is this linear charge density converter?
**A:** It uses 3 canonical unit definitions and 12-digit precision constants.

**Q:** Is it free?
**A:** Yes — completely free, no signup, no limits.

**Q:** Which units are supported?
**A:** Coulomb/meter (C/m), Coulomb/centimeter (C/cm), Coulomb/inch (C/in).
